description: Contrail: record whether this Claude Code session has Remote Control connected, right before a Contrail tool that mints an approval code — so the code is pushed to your phone only when you could type it from there. Writes a yes/no, a timestamp, the Contrail tool's name and Claude Code's id for the call under Contrail's data directory (never your session link, never the tool's arguments); never blocks a tool call. See TOOLS.md → open_settings ('When a push goes out'), or Getting Started → 'Get approval codes on your phone'.
